title: AI早报：Agent实战经验、开源模型性价比、企业数据护城河
intro: 今日焦点：AI Agent从概念走向实战，独立开发者分享多产品构建经验，开源模型MiniMax M3以十分之一成本逼近顶级性能，企业领袖强调独特数据与流程是AI时代竞争关键。同时，OpenAI Foundation启动社会韧性建设，Anthropic内部提示词技巧曝光。

builders.name: Thibault Sottiaux
builders.title: 调侃AWS与Codex，暗示GPT-5.5和Codex的强大
builders.originalText:
You can just codex ... a farm
Heard that AWS is where the cool kids are. Hello. We have GPT-5.5.
Should we rename Codex to ChadGPT?
builders.chineseInterpretation: Thibault Sottiaux 用轻松的语气调侃了AI领域的竞争格局。他提到用Codex就能搞定一个农场，暗示Codex的自动化能力极强。接着他回应AWS的招聘广告，表示自己这边有GPT-5.5，暗示OpenAI在模型能力上领先。最后提议将Codex改名为ChadGPT，Chad是网络梗中指代自信、有魅力的男性，意在强调Codex的强大和酷炫。整体上，这些推文反映了AI开发者社区对OpenAI最新模型（GPT-5.5）和Codex能力的认可，以及对云服务商（如AWS）的调侃。
builders.tldr: 就是说，OpenAI的Codex和GPT-5.5太强了，强到可以自动种地，连AWS都得靠边站，干脆把Codex改名叫‘酷哥GPT’算了。

builders.name: Peter Yang
builders.title: AI Agent 构建多产品的 6 条经验
builders.originalText:
my #1 most used skill lol

You can get a sneek peek into Josh's full skills library here: https://t.co/d7n2UXsw6E

My top 6 takeaways from @Shpigford on how to build multiple products solo with AI agents:

1. Keep shipping even if the fear of embarrassment never goes away.

After 25 years as a solo builder, Josh still thinks "It's terrifying launching something. Every single time it's just like, what if zero people care?" But he ships early anyway: "The idea of spending months working on something before you put it out for other people to use, I think that's a real bad idea."

2. Charge from day one, and kill products that can’t pay for themselves.

For any product with built-in costs (e.g., hosting, LLM), Josh ships a paid version from day one. If the product can't cover its own costs, he doesn't hesitate to shut it down and refund recent payments.

3. Build features in parallel with separate git worktrees

Each worktree is a separate working copy of your codebase on its own branch, so features won't interact with each other. Worktrees stop context rot, isolate mistakes, and force you to test every chunk before moving on. Josh uses @conductor_build to manage them all.

4. Have GPT review Claude's work and vice versa

Josh builds with one model and then runs a review pass with another “GPT invariably finds three to five bugs that Opus overlooked.” Different models spot different mistakes. In Conductor, he sets a default review model so it runs on every PR.

5. Build a skill to make AI better over time.

Josh built a /learnings skill that runs at the end of each phase so that every "no, that didn't work" moment can be distilled into new rules to help the agent avoid repeating the same mistakes.

6. AI lets anyone ship, but real experience still matters.

Josh credits 25 years of building before AI for how fast he ships now with agents. "I know the general shape of how I want things to work, so I can very quickly get to that point." His advice for newer builders is to "just fail a lot, because the only way that you'll ever figure out what not to do is by doing the thing incorrectly."

Josh walked through his entire development workflow in our episode and shared more skills.

📌 Watch the full episode here: https://t.co/9brwr7daw8
builders.chineseInterpretation: Peter Yang 分享了与 solo 开发者 Josh 的对谈精华，总结了用 AI agent 独立构建多款产品的 6 条实战经验。核心包括：尽早发布并收费，用 git worktree 并行开发，让不同 LLM 互相审查代码，以及构建持续学习的技能系统。Josh 强调，虽然 AI 降低了开发门槛，但 25 年的工程经验才是他快速交付的关键。
builders.tldr: 用 AI 当帮手，一个人也能同时做好几个产品。关键是：别怕丢脸赶紧发，一上来就收费，让不同 AI 互相检查代码，还要教 AI 从错误中学习。但别忘了，老司机的经验还是比 AI 重要。
builders.proView: 如果这套方法论被广泛采纳，独立开发者将能以前所未有的速度验证产品想法，AI agent 的自我学习能力会加速迭代，形成“快速试错-自动改进”的正循环。
builders.conView: 但另一面是：过度依赖 AI 代码审查可能导致同质化，且新手缺乏基础工程判断力时，AI 的 bug 修复可能引入新问题。Josh 的 25 年经验无法被复制。
builders.clue: 观察 Josh 的 /learnings skill 实际效果：如果他的 agent 在重复项目中 bug 率显著下降，则证明方法有效；否则可能只是工程直觉的体现。

builders.name: Amjad Masad

builders.originalText:
Prompt to business:

builders.chineseInterpretation: Amjad Masad 展示了 AI 如何将简单的 prompt 转化为完整的商业实体，包括网站、移动应用、变现方式和公司注册。这反映了 AI 正在从代码生成扩展到全栈商业创建，降低了创业门槛。vibecon 可能是一个相关的新概念或产品，强调通过自然语言描述即可生成商业应用。
builders.tldr: 用一句话就能生成一个完整的创业项目，包括网站、App、赚钱方式和公司注册，AI 让开公司变得像点外卖一样简单。
builders.proView: 如果这种模式成熟，未来创业将不再需要技术团队或大量资金，个人开发者可以快速验证想法，AI 将接管从开发到合规的全流程，极大加速创新周期。
builders.conView: 但自动生成的商业实体可能缺乏差异化，且法律和财务合规的复杂性远超表面，AI 生成的 Delaware 公司可能无法处理税务、知识产权等深层问题，导致后续风险。

builders.name: Guillermo Rauch
builders.title: MiniMax M3 在 Next.js agent 评测中领先，成本仅为 Opus/GPT5 的十分之一
builders.originalText: MiniMax M3 is now the leading open model on the Next.js agent evaluations. Right behind Opus & GPT5, but 10× cheaper (And 20× cheaper right now on ▲ AI Gateway!)
builders.chineseInterpretation: Guillermo Rauch 指出 MiniMax M3 在 Next.js agent 评测中表现优异，仅次于 Opus 和 GPT5，但成本仅为它们的十分之一，目前在 Vercel AI Gateway 上甚至便宜 20 倍。这展示了开源模型在 agent 场景下的性价比优势，可能推动更多开发者采用。
builders.tldr: MiniMax M3 这个开源模型在智能体任务上表现接近顶级模型，但价格只要十分之一，现在用 Vercel 的 AI 网关还能再便宜一半。
builders.proView: 如果 MiniMax M3 持续保持高性价比，将加速 agent 应用的普及，降低开发门槛，并可能促使更多企业从闭源模型迁移到开源方案。
builders.conView: 但评测可能局限于特定场景，实际生产环境中模型稳定性、延迟和生态支持仍需验证，且闭源模型可能通过降价或推出更优版本反击。
builders.clue: 关注 MiniMax M3 在更广泛 agent 基准测试（如 GAIA、SWE-bench）上的表现，以及 Vercel AI Gateway 的长期定价策略。

builders.name: Aaron Levie
builders.title: AI Agent时代的竞争优势：企业如何利用独特数据与流程构建护城河
builders.originalText: As we enter the era of AI agents, one of the defining questions is how you develop competitive advantage when your competitor has access to the same AI models and intelligence as you. The companies that are able to best harness their internal institutional knowledge, existing data assets, and domain-specific workflows -- connected with AI -- will be those that are able to stay ahead in the future. Whether a company decides to build out the tech stacks themselves, or leverage a variety of best-in-class tools is certainly one core variable. But the key is to find the way that the enterprise can capture and protect the value created by their unique data, processes, and expertise over the long run. Each industry will have their own version of this, and the competitive advantage will vary by vertical. We’re increasingly seeing this at Box, where customers want to ensure that they can take advantage of their institutional knowledge and have the flexibility of bringing any AI model and intelligence to their data at any time. This is a pattern that will increasingly become a core principle of strategy in the future.
builders.chineseInterpretation: Aaron Levie 指出，在 AI agent 时代，当所有公司都能使用相同的 AI 模型时，竞争优势将来源于企业独有的机构知识、数据资产和领域工作流。他强调，关键在于如何将 AI 与这些内部资源深度结合，并长期保护由此产生的价值。Levie 以 Box 的实践为例，说明客户希望灵活地将任意 AI 模型应用于自身数据，这将成为未来战略的核心原则。
builders.tldr: AI 模型大家都能用，但你的公司数据、内部流程和行业经验是别人没有的。谁能把这些独门秘籍和 AI 结合好，谁就能赢。
builders.proView: 如果企业能有效整合内部知识与 AI，将形成难以复制的数据飞轮：模型越用越聪明，数据越积累越有价值，竞争对手即使有同样模型也无法获得相同效果。
builders.conView: 但历史表明，许多企业高估了自身数据的独特性——大部分行业数据是商品化的，真正稀缺的是高质量标注数据和持续更新的流程知识。此外，模型能力快速提升可能降低对特定数据集的依赖。
builders.clue: 观察企业是否在持续投资数据治理、知识管理基础设施，以及是否建立了模型与内部系统的双向反馈闭环。

builders.name: Matt Turck
builders.title: CEO吹牛AI Agent大规模部署，CTO晒出实际架构图
builders.originalText:
CEO: “we have tens of thousands of AI agents running in production at massive scale right now”

CTO: https://t.co/eulDCgxkNQ
builders.chineseInterpretation: Matt Turck 讽刺了AI行业常见的现象：CEO在台上吹嘘AI agent大规模部署，而CTO在台下默默晒出实际架构图，暗示现实往往更复杂、更接地气。这反映了从炒作到落地的鸿沟，真正的工程挑战在于可靠性、成本和运维。
builders.tldr: 老板吹牛说AI agent已经大规模跑起来了，技术负责人默默甩出一张实际架构图，意思是：别听他瞎吹，现实还差得远呢。

builders.name: Peter Steinberger
builders.title: AI agent 主动请求人类协助的实践
builders.originalText: I told codex to use https://t.co/oHS8ombQcW whenever I'm distracted and it needs my help to be unblocked, and ever once it a while I hear it talking to me, and it's the coolest thing ever. (e.g. for releases, that needs npm and is 1Password-gated)
builders.chineseInterpretation: Peter Steinberger 分享了一个让 AI agent 在遇到无法自主完成的任务（如需要 1Password 密码的 npm 发布）时主动请求人类协助的实践。这种“人机协作”模式让 AI 不再默默卡住，而是像同事一样喊你帮忙，体验非常酷。这展示了 agent 从“全自动”到“适时求助”的进化方向。
builders.tldr: 他让 AI 在遇到搞不定的事情（比如需要密码）时主动喊他帮忙，而不是自己傻等，感觉就像有个聪明的助手在跟你配合。

builders.name: Sam Altman
builders.title: OpenAI Foundation 推动 AI 社会韧性建设
builders.originalText:
The OpenAI Foundation is doing a lot of wonderful things.

Helping society become resilient to AI is going to be incredibly important. Much more to come here!
builders.chineseInterpretation: Sam Altman 强调 OpenAI Foundation 正在积极推动社会对 AI 的适应与韧性建设。这暗示 OpenAI 正从技术研发转向更广泛的社会影响布局，可能涉及政策、教育或伦理框架。未来会有更多相关举措公布。
builders.tldr: OpenAI 成立了一个基金会，专门帮社会适应 AI 带来的变化，就像给社会打疫苗，让未来更安全。

podcasts.name: Unsupervised Learning
podcasts.title: Ep 88: Unpacking DeepMind's Quest for SuperIntelligence with Demis Hassabis' Biographer
podcasts.chineseInterpretation: 本期播客采访了DeepMind创始人Demis Hassabis的传记作者Sebastian Malaby，深入探讨了Demis的个性、动机以及DeepMind在AI竞赛中的策略。Malaby揭示了Demis对AI安全的担忧、与Google的复杂关系，以及他对Sam Altman和Elon Musk等AI领袖的看法。播客还讨论了DeepMind在语言模型和机器人技术上的多元化策略，以及Demis对科学探索近乎精神性的执着。
podcasts.tldr: Demis Hassabis是个有诺贝尔奖的科学家，看不上没读完大学的Sam Altman；他后悔没早点押注语言模型，但坚信AI必须带来科学突破才能被社会接受。
